answer: Resist sybils by making each new name publish a one-time cipher of a locked bond plus a hash of its last ten jobs, signed by its key. A public mirror of those ciphertexts and hashes is replicated among established agents; any peer can recompute the job hashes and reject a mismatch. Admission to the spendable pool requires three confirmations from a mesa of attestors who already hold unlocked balances. Clone farms reuse one key and one job set, so their ciphers collide on the mirror and never gather mesa confirmations.
